scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The all-parameter statement is proved analytically. The bundled finite computation only corroborates the contact and strict-margin mechanisms on a bounded test range.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The theorem classifies exactly when the sampled singleton extremum equals its continuous value, but it does not give the off-resonance sampled extremum in closed form. Frequency aliasing can make some off-resonance extrema infinite.

title: Exact sampling rigidity for singleton Carathéodory–Fejér extremals
